title: [Master] - Slice 611452: [AT][IC][RegF] Enable Danish SAF-T to be used in Austria and Iceland
summary: Danish SAF-T functionality is now available for Austria and Iceland through core SAF-T modifications, moving country-specific code from a dedicated Danish app to the main SAF-T application.
key_points: Danish SAF-T customizations migrated from SAFTModificationDK app to the main SAF-T app
SAF-T now supports Austria and Iceland in addition to Denmark
Multiple codeunits, queries, and table extensions updated to accommodate regional functionality
Build configurations updated for Austria and Iceland projects
Test coverage expanded to include new localizations
